extension.title: Browser Extension
extension.subtitle: One-click saving of paper PDFs and metadata from the web to your local PaperForge library
extension.downloadDesc: Download the zip, extract it to a folder, then load the unpacked folder in Chrome/Edge developer mode.
extension.step1: Open Chrome/Edge extensions page (chrome://extensions or edge://extensions)
extension.step2: Turn on Developer mode in the top-right corner
extension.step3: Click Load unpacked and select the extracted extension folder
extension.note: The extension connects to the local PaperForge backend at http://localhost:8770 by default. Make sure the backend is running.
